description: src/holon_coherence/providers/translation.py splits streaming TCP chunks on newlines without carrying incomplete lines across chunks and maps streaming vs non-streaming finish_reason values inconsistently.
goal: Fix streaming SSE translation in src/holon_coherence/providers/translation.py (keeping it strictly at or below 442 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json): maintain an incomplete-line carry buffer inside stream_state across translate_openai_sse_chunk_to_gemini calls so JSON SSE lines split across arbitrary TCP chunk boundaries are reassembled rather than dropped, and align streaming vs non-streaming finish_reason mapping for equivalent stop states. Add unit tests in tests/providers/test_translation.py covering split mid-JSON SSE lines across multiple chunks and finish_reason parity between streaming and non-streaming translation. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: TCP chunk fragmentation frequently splits data: JSON lines in transit; carrying partial lines in stream_state and matching finish_reason prevents silent event loss and response-format drift.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/providers/translation.py carries incomplete SSE lines in stream_state across chunk boundaries and aligns streaming/non-streaming finish_reason mappings while staying at most 442 lines without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
tests/providers/test_translation.py verifies mid-JSON chunked SSE reassembly and finish_reason parity with zero docstrings or comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass.
